datasetName: Yale Bright Star Catalogue visual subset with Hipparcos distances
role: 太阳附近可分辨亮星的观测锚点
upstreamCatalog: Yale Bright Star Catalogue, Fifth Revised Edition
license: The source repository identifies the Yale Bright Star Catalogue data as public domain.

validity.positionPropagation: Only entries with positive finite distance are transformed into Galactocentric three-dimensional positions.
knownLimitations: The catalogue is a bright-star subset rather than a complete Gaia source sample.
The inferred absolute magnitude retains the extinction already present on the solar line of sight.
For a displaced observer, the renderer applies modelled differential extinction relative to the solar anchor.
